name: Cante jondo siguiriya (deepest flamenco)
lineage: Andalusian cante jondo siguiriya: the deepest, most tragic-emotional palo (song-form) of the cante jondo "deep song" flamenco core repertoire. Characterized by the canonical siguiriya twelve-beat compás (3+3+2+2+2), extended free-rhythm extended-melismatic introductory passages, and intense vocal-emotional projection registering the genre's anguished-lament aesthetic. Lyric content addresses death, the loss of loved ones, the pain of incarceration, the suffering of the Roma-Andalusian historical experience. Distinguished within the cante jondo palos by siguiriya's tragic-anguish (vs the soleá's graver-philosophical or the martinete's a-cappella-direct) emotional register. The canonical siguiriya repertoire descends through hereditary cantaor lineages with strict transmission-conservation conventions.
